svg.title: The Linux Filesystem - ChicanoDev
svg.desc: A directory reference covering the filesystem root, 20 common top-level paths, and important subdirectories of usr and var.
svg.text: One tree. Every path has a place.
The starting point of every absolute path. Disks, devices, and other filesystems join this single tree at mount
